analysis.reason: 3거래일 연속 관망 유지. RSI는 50선 부근에서 횡보하며 방향성 부재. ADX 9.3으로 추세 강도 미약. 5일 평균 거래량비 0.94로 거래량 동반 없는 움직임. 268,500원 현재가 기준, 스윙 지지 246,000원, 저항 279,000원 구간 내 횡보 지속.
analysis.reasonEn: Maintaining a wait-and-see approach for 3 consecutive trading days. RSI is consolidating around the 50-level, indicating a lack of directional momentum. ADX at 9.3 suggests weak trend strength. Trading volume ratio at 0.94 of the 5-day average shows unconvincing price action. The current price of 268,500 KRW remains within the swing support of 246,000 KRW and resistance of 279,000 KRW, with continued consolidation.

· SMA100(280,881원) 하회, SMA200(224,656원) 상회: 중장기 추세 약세 전환.
· 52주 위치(63.4%): 가격대 역사적 중간 수준.
[모멘텀 지표]
· RSI 궤적 (57.2→52.2): 중립 구간 지속, 과매도 탈출 후 중립 유지.
· MACD 히스토그램 궤적 (716.9177→1356.5256): 개선 중, 바닥 다지기 신호.
· 볼린저밴드 현재가 위치 (중단 263,300원): 중단 부근 횡보, 밴드폭 15.77%로 변동성 보통.
[지지·저항 구조]

· 스윙 저항선 (279,000원): 돌파 시 단기 상승 전환 가능성.
· 5일 고가/저가 (285,500원/266,000원), 20일 고가/저가 (285,500원/243,000원): 횡보 패턴.
[거래량·결론]
· 거래량 비율 (0.94배): 움직임의 신뢰도 보통.
· 현 구간 진단 (축적구간): 268,500원 현재가 기준, 246,000원~279,000원 박스권 횡보 지속, 방향성 부재로 관망 유지.
analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (268,500 KRW) below SMA5 (274,600 KRW), above SMA20 (263,300 KRW) and SMA50 (255,650 KRW): indicating a short-term trend shift to weak, while mid-term trend remains strong.
· Below SMA100 (280,881 KRW) and above SMA200 (224,656 KRW): suggesting a shift to a weak mid-to-long-term trend.
· 52-week position (63.4%): price is at a historical intermediate level.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (57.2→52.2): neutral range continuation, holding neutral after exiting oversold.
· MACD histogram trajectory (716.9177→1356.5256): improving, signaling bottoming action.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Middle Band 263,300 KRW): consolidating near the middle band, with a band width of 15.77% indicating moderate volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support (246,000 KRW): based on Pivot S1 (245,833 KRW).
· Swing resistance (279,000 KRW): potential for a short-term upward reversal if breached.
· 5-day high/low (285,500 KRW/266,000 KRW), 20-day high/low (285,500 KRW/243,000 KRW): consolidation pattern.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.94x): moderate confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation Phase): Current price at 268,500 KRW is within the 246,000 KRW to 279,000 KRW range, with continued sideways movement and lack of direction, warranting a wait-and-see approach.
